name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, and identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs while keeping SUB-only and DUB-only files correctly labeled.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Production WCO provider with title-aware movies and Season 0 specials, Episode 0 and fractional-special fallbacks, separate Dub/Sub sources, season and range matching, and real mirror handling: WCO server/CDN are deduplicated when identical and exposed separately only when distinct, with the top two qualities kept per real mirror and a maximum of four sources per audio branch.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: WCO Domain Test
scrapers.description: Temporary isolated WCO frontend fallback test. Runs the same normal TV/anime episode independently through wcoflix, wcoforever, wco.tv, wcoanimedub, and wcoanimesub, returning only the best Dub and best Sub result per domain so useful fallback frontends can be identified without changing production WCO.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO domain test
